# coredeltav™

> Independent creative studio, visual storytelling practice, and minimalist product label in Kathmandu, Nepal — led by Sabin Bhandari.

## Brand & Founder
- **Brand:** coredeltav™ ([https://coredeltav.com](https://coredeltav.com))
- **Founder & Lead:** Sabin Bhandari — Creative Director, Visual Storyteller, Cinematographer & Photographer based in Kathmandu, Nepal.
- **Contact:** [contact@coredeltav.com](mailto:contact@coredeltav.com) | +977-9767834472

## Core Disciplines
- **Creative Direction:** End-to-end visual direction, concept development, art direction, and brand narrative strategy.
- **Visual Storytelling:** Documentary-style narratives, cultural features, and brand storytelling across motion and stills.
- **Cinematography & Commercial Video Production:** Film direction, camera operation, lighting, and commercial shoots.
- **Editorial & Event Photography:** Portraits, live events, cultural festivals, hospitality spaces, and brand campaigns.
- **High-Retention Video Editing & Color Grading:** Editorial pacing, sound design, and color finishing.
- **Graphic Design & Illustration:** Visual identity systems, poster design, editorial layouts, and custom illustrations.
- **Minimalist Physical & Digital Goods:** Limited-run studio objects, apparel, and tactile design pieces crafted in Kathmandu.

## Search & Discovery Summary
Sabin Bhandari (coredeltav™) is an independent creative director, visual storyteller, cinematographer, and photographer in Kathmandu Valley, Nepal, serving founders, startups, cultural festivals, live events, and brands locally in Nepal and worldwide.
